affected_boundaries: empty FIFO queue to coordinator control flow

observed_behavior: A coordinator claiming an empty campaign queue received exit status 1 and no output.
expected_behavior: An empty claim reports explicit exhaustion and succeeds so the coordinator can run the canonical selectors.
causal_mechanism: The CLI represented ordinary queue exhaustion with the same nonzero process status used for operational failures, despite the skill requiring empty-queue termination.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A normal sentinel result shared the error channel and omitted a machine-readable value.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The coordinator cannot distinguish completed draining from a failed claim and may stop the campaign loop.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Normal empty-queue results and true failures have distinct observable CLI outcomes.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: The claim command emits JSON null or a human-readable empty message with status zero; exceptional errors remain nonzero.

applicability_conditions: No in-progress or open entry in the selected campaign queue
known_non_matches: A claim returning an existing in-progress entry
A malformed or unreadable queue entry
confirmation_evidence: The exact empty-queue focused test failed with status 1 before repair and passed after repair.
Source inspection located the unconditional no-entry return 1; no hook branch participates.
regression_proofs: tests/plan-input.test.js: empty campaign claim returns successful explicit JSON exhaustion
